task: Dear <Ranger>! We have received information saying that there is a secret base of the famous Peleng Lyakusha named Borzukhan on the uninhabited planet of <ToPlanet> in <ToStar> system. Right now we are planning an operation to find and destroy that base, but we need a sufficiently experienced fighter to accomplish this mission. If you agree, you will have to go to the planet of <ToPlanet> within <Day> days. We already have a camp deployed on the planet, where our agents who will brief you on the mission will meet you. You shouldn't have any problems finding the camp; there's a radio beacon nearby. Your fee for this mission will round up to <Money> cr.
success: Welcome, dear <Ranger>! We have already received the report on your outstanding performance on the mission to search and destroy Borzukhan's secret base! As has been arranged we are paying you a fee of <Money> cr.
loc.2.0:
In the camp you were met by the agent of planet <FromPlanet>.
- Dear <Ranger>, I am glad to meet you here at the planet of <ToPlanet>. My name is Carl. As you have probably been told already, your objective here is to locate and destroy a secret Peleng base, known as Lyakusha Borzukhan. The main thing is to destroy the base. At that you will most likely encounter resistance form Borzuklhan himself. If that is the case, you have the full responsibility of what to do, but it would be better if you mange to take the Peleng alive. If you manage to do that we will pay you an extra <clr>1000<clrEnd> cr as a bonus. If you have any questions ask now and I will try to tell you everything I know myself.
loc.3.0: - Of course we are not going to send you there unarmed. You will get a laser gun and several grenades in case you run into armed guards. In addition to that we are going to give you a special explosive device with remote control detonator. You will have to find out what is the base's weakest spot and set the explosives there. But do not forget that the capturing of Lyakusha Borzukhan himself is no less important. As I've already mentioned we'd rather that you take him alive, for which we will pay you a bonus, but if that proves impossible you can kill him. In any event do not let him escape!
loc.4.0:
- This may surely become a difficult task, since the planet is rather large. Although I could still advise you on the locations, where, we think, the base is most likely to be found. The three most possible base locations are, in our opinion, the mountains north of our camp, the forest south-west of the camp, or the underground caves, which you can reach via a grotto in the east, by the coast. 
But, in any event, keep your eyes open and your ears pricked, it is quite likely that we do not know everything, so do not let this information misguide you.
loc.5.0:
- Excellent! But before you start off, you must receive your munitions. You are not going to fight Borzukhan empty-handed, are you? So: you will get an explosive charge to destroy the base itself, a laser gun and several grenades. Unfortunately our arms supply is rather limited, since the pilot who navigated the transport that was supposed to deliver the arms here, turned out to be a Peleng hallucinogen addict and ended up colliding with five asteroids at once. I hope you are not hooked on anything like that, are you?
It's a long distance to walk, so we will give you a light flyer. It is pretty small and sufficiently shielded, so the enemy is not likely to detect you, unless you expose yourself. We will show you a picture of Borzukhan, so that you recognise him. That's it. Be careful and attentive, and good luck!
loc.6.0: - Of course, we could have sent our people in advance, so that they located the base, but we do not have any agents who'd be experienced enough to do the job. We fear that an inexperienced trooper could accidentally frighten Borzukhan off. If he learns that we have detected his base, he will surely relocate it somewhere else, quite possibly onto another planet altogether, and we will have to look for him again. I hope you understand how important your mission is. By the way, we have some data about the possible locations of the lyakusha's base. I'll mark those up on your map.
loc.6.1: - Of course, we could have sent our people in advance, so that they located the base, but we do not have any agents who'd be experienced enough to do the job. We fear that an inexperienced trooper could accidentally frighten Borzukhan off. If he learns that we have detected his base, he will surely relocate it somewhere else, quite possibly onto another planet altogether, and we will have to look for him again. I hope you understand how important you mission is.
loc.7.0: You are sitting in a light flyer and contemplate where you should go.
loc.8.0: You circled over the mountains north of the camp and soon detected a cave opening.
loc.9.0: You are circling over the woods. From this height you cannot see anything suspicious. Maybe you should descend?
loc.10.0: You landed the flyer in the coastal cliffs. Nothing suspicious around here.
loc.11.0: You circled around the camp. To the north you saw a high range. To the west and south of the camp there was an endless swamp. In the south-west there was a forest. When you turned east you saw the ocean and the rocky coast. "So where do I go from here?" - you thought to yourself. Suddenly in the south, right in the middle of the swamp you noticed a thin trace of smoke
loc.12.0: You followed the smoke and soon beheld a group of creatures gathered around a fire. From this distance you still could not make out who they were or what they were doing.
loc.13.0: You carefully landed the flyer not far from the fire, behind a huge rock, where no one could see it. Now you could see a group of five very unfriendly looking Pelengs sitting by the fire and discussing something. By their side there lay a Human - motionless. He looks like he's been stunned with a powerful stunner charge.
loc.14.0: Without thinking twice, you headed your flyer right to the fire. When you closed in, you saw that the five creatures gathered around the fire were Pelengs. Then suddenly one of them turned his head in your direction and yelled something. The rest of the bunch were on their feet in a flick of a wrist, guns blazing. Several shots hit your flyer.
loc.15.0: Several seconds later it was all over, although you got your portion as well. But since you did not have enough time to aim, you spent more charges than was required. Now that the Pelengs were taken car of you noticed a man lying motionless by the fire. He looked like he'd been stunned with a powerful stunner charge.
loc.16.0: You took a grenade and threw it right in the middle of the group. A loud explosion shook the air. Now the swamp was covered in fragments of green Peleng bodies. However now you are not going to learn what they were doing here at the fire, since the explosion destroyed everything, that could have given you any hints.
loc.17.0: You turned your flyer and flew away not wanting to mess with this bunch.
loc.18.0: You turned your flyer and flew away.
loc.19.0:
You turned to the motionless man and tried to bring him back to consciousness. At first you couldn't do much about it but finally he opened his eyes and moaned:
- Where am I? Who are you?
loc.20.0: Having searched the bodies of the killed Pelengs, you found several laser gun charges on one of them. Looks like this guy did not have the time to use it. Well, too bad for him, and you really could use some extra ammo. You also picked up the stunner which was used to take out the poor sod, lying there unconscious. The stunner was almost discharged but it was still good for one or two shots.
loc.21.0: - Thank you, <Ranger>, for... for s-saving me... f-from these scoundrels, - the man spoke with difficulty, - I-I was a simple... merchant... They captured me right at the spaceport... where was it... I am sorry, I can't remember the name of that planet. They demanded a ransom, but I c-couldn't pay the sum they asked for. So they... concussed me and brought me here. I came to once, and heard them talk something about some Borzukhan. Is this the guy you are looking for? I heard something about the mountains... and they also said something about some secret passage on the coast... Unfortunately I cannot tell you anything in more... details, since, once they noticed I was listening, the stunned me again... Please, could you help me get some place, from where I could get out of this hole?
loc.23.0: You pricked up your ears and tried to make out what the Pelengs were talking about. By the fragments of their conversation you understood you were in the right: the bunch gathered by the fire was Borzukhan's pirate squad, hailing back from "business" and intending to deliver the prisoner to the base.
loc.24.0: Hiding behind the rock, you produced your laser gun, and taking your aim carefully opened fire at the Pelengs. After the first accurate shot, the remaining four Pelengs, jumped to their feet, screaming in panic, and trying to figure out where the fire is coming from. Four more shots - and it was all over.
loc.25.0: You took a grenade and threw it right in the middle of the group. A loud explosion shook the air. The unsuspecting Pelengs were blasted apart. Unfortunately the man who lied nearby was no immortal either, so chances are you will never learn who he was and how he got here.
loc.26.0: You continued listening to the pirate conversation and heard one of them complain about the habit of their boss Borzukhan spend time all by himself in a small cabin somewhere in the woods to the west. The pirate was sure that this habit was not going to do the boss any good, and you couldn't but agree with him, especially considering the fact that this cretin blurted out a bunch of orientation points, knowing which finding the lyakusha's cabin was a piece of cake!
loc.27.0: You took out your laser gun and opened fire. However the enemy returned the fire, so you couldn't really aim properly, and soon were out of charges. You tried t turn the flyer back and fly away, but it was too late. The next shot went straight into the engine, the flyer dropped like a stone, and exploded...
loc.28.0: You walked about the forest for a while, but found nothing suspicious.
loc.29.0: After a long walk about the forest, you went into a meadow, in the middle of which there was a small wooden cabin with glassed windows. Looks like even these days there are folks who like living at one with nature! The question is whom the cabin belongs to?
loc.29.1: Remembering the conversation of the pirates that you'd overheard, you decided to find the cabin, which, they claimed, Lyakusha Borzukhan liked to spend his time in. Since you knew all the main orientation points, the task proved to be quite easy. After several minutes of cautious wandering around the forest you stepped onto a meadow, in the middle of which you indeed saw a wooden cabin with glassed windows. Looks like even these days and even among the pirates there are still folks who like living at one with nature!
loc.29.2: You went back to the forest cabin.
loc.29.3: You went back to the forest cabin.
loc.31.0: You crawled up to the window and cautiously peeked inside. In the armchair right in the middle of an expensively furnished room sat Lyakusha Borzukhan himself. Apparently he didn't notice you.
loc.32.0: You took the grenade and threw it right through the window. An explosion thundered sending wooden splinters fly all around the place. When the smoke cleared you noticed pieces of green meat amidst the debris. Looks like this was all that was left of Borzukhan, although, identifying him as one now, would pose some difficulty.
loc.33.0: You kicked the door in and burst into the cabin. Borzukhan jumped up from his armchair searching frantically for his laser gun, that lay nearby.
loc.34.0:
You went to the door and knocked politely. You heard somebody pace quickly up to the door and stop - apparently the Peleng was studying you through the peephole. Then you heard a sharp voice:
- Who are you, and what do you want here? Answer quickly and don't mess with me here!
loc.36.0:
You heard the Peleng burst out laughing:
- A forester?! Here on <ToPlanet>? Now that was a real-real good one, lad! Unfortunately I am afraid I can't let you go but I will give you the benefit of a quick death!
The door swung open and an accurate shot from a laser gun went right through your head.
loc.38.0: - Looking for me, pal? Well, you found me. And what is it that you wanted to tell me?
loc.39.0:
- No so fast, lad! What, you really thought you could come in here, tell me you were looking for me, and then just leave like that?! 
The door swung open and you saw the barrel of a laser shotgun aimed right at your head. This was the last thing you saw in your life...
loc.40.0: You shot your laser gun through the door, but the Lyakusha was not that stupid and stood to the side of the door so you missed. Borzukhan swung the door open and his accurate shot blasted your head into fragment like a ripe watermelon.
loc.41.0:
The door swung open and you saw a laser gun pointed right at you. A second later the Peleng pulled the trigger and you rolled on the ground shrieking and trying to cover the hole in your belly. Chuckling at you, Borzukhan said:
- I am sorry lad, but arrogance must not go around unchecked.
With this said, he closed the door and left you bleeding there. Your death came slow and painful...
loc.42.0: You took out the stunner and shot. Unfortunately the glass on the window dispersed the energy charge and Borzukhan was only slightly concussed. He quickly jumped to his feet, grabbed his laser gun, and downed you with one accurate shot.
loc.44.0: Fortunately enough he wasn't that good a shot, and you were only scratched. Oh well, so much for Borzukhan, now it's time for his base.
loc.45.0: You quickly shot your stunner and Borzukhan sank down to the floor. The stunner was out of charges now and you threw it away.
loc.46.0: You shot at Borzukhan with your laser gun, but he ducked and the shot went past him. The Lyakusha reached quickly for his own weapon, and that brought a horrified understanding that you were out of charge. It was too late to run, and a second later the Peleng boss shot you dead.
loc.48.0: Going down to the sea you found a grotto.
loc.49.0: You decided you needed to relax and undressing quickly went into the sea. The water was magnificent and - forgetting all caution - you swam too far from the coast. When you noticed some strange waves right near you it was already too late. A huge sea beast devoured you.
loc.51.0: You carefully stepped into the grotto and saw a huge tunnel that led to a cave. You went down the passage hoping to find Borzukhan's base but soon ran into a wall.
loc.52.0: Remembering the words of the rescued merchant about the secret tunnel, you decided to take a careful look around. Soon you found a well-masked lever on the wall. When you turned the lever, part of the wall quietly moved to the side and a dark passage opened in front of you.
loc.53.0: You followed the passage and soon found a door. Carefully pulling the handle you saw the door was not locked. How careless these pirates are!
loc.54.0: You headed your flyer to the cave, when suddenly a group of pirates with laser guns ran out and opened fire at you!
loc.55.0:
You quickly turned the flyer and flew away. You managed to get away alive but now the enemy has been warned and would surely take all the necessary precautions. Now you won't be able to sneak into the base or let alone destroy it. 

<clr>Mission failed.<clrEnd>
loc.56.0:
You started firing at the guards from the laser gun, but they were all well hidden behind the rocks and you simply ran out of rounds. And the pirates continued shooting at you...
Looks like its time to get the hell out of here!
loc.57.0: You started firing at the guards from the laser gun, but they were all well hidden behind the rocks and returned the fire. Finally you managed to wipe them all out but you spent too many rounds. Besides your flyer was seriously damaged, and you yourself were wounded too.
loc.58.0: You took out a grenade and threw it at the guards. The explosion shook the rocks. You had a free way now.
loc.59.0: You landed the flyer behind the nearest rock, and cautiously stepped into the cave. In front of you there was a long corridor. You made a few steps down, but soon saw a large group of Pelengs, running towards you! Looks like the grenade explosion has attracted the guards' attention!
loc.60.0: You grabbed your laser gun and opened fire at the pirates. However there was too many of them and you had too few rounds, and very quickly you ended up shot.
loc.61.0:
You cast a grenade into the crowd of enemies. The explosion tore them apart, but the walls and ceiling crumbled as well, blocking the passage. Now you wouldn't be able to get to Borzukhan's base: even if you find some other way there, it'll take too long, and the enemy has been warned already. 

<clr>Mission failed.<clrEnd>
loc.62.0: You rushed out of the cave and crouched behind a rock. The enemies ran out and looked around searching for you.
loc.63.0: You tried to circle the pirates and quietly sneak into the cave, but they noticed you and shot.
loc.64.0: You tried to jump to your feet and run for the flyer, but they noticed you and shot.
loc.65.0: You tossed a grenade into the crowd of pirates and blew them apart. Once again the way was free.
loc.66.0: You went down the corridor. Several minutes later you ran into a ramification. One corridor on the left, one on the right. Nearby there was a door. Putting you ear thereto you heard somebody talk and laugh behind the door.
loc.67.0:
Going left you ran into a row of barred cells. Looks like these were used to keep the pirates' prisoners. A guard slept peacefully nearby. "Right!" - you thought to yourself. - "Looks like even Borzukhan's pirates are quite undisciplined!"
Suddenly the guard moved and mumbled something incoherent. You froze in your steps, but apparently he was still asleep. Still you should keep it quiet so as not to wake him up.
loc.67.1: You are standing at Borzukhan's prison sells. A guard is sleeping peacefully nearby.
loc.68.0: You took the right corridor and soon reached a spacious hall with tables. Looks like this is a canteen. Luckily enough it was empty. In the opposite wall of the canteen you noticed two doors.
loc.68.1: You are at Lyakusha Borzukhan's canteen.
loc.69.0: You opened the door and stepped right in. Big mistake - you went right into the guardroom. The Pelengs surprised as they were by this intrusion quickly shot you dead.
loc.70.0: You opened the door and cautiously stepped into a dimly lit room, noticing, that the door was carefully masked from the inside and was almost unnoticeable. One corridor lead to the left, the other one to the right, and there also was a door. Cocking an ear, you heard somebody laugh and talk behind it. The third corridor was rather long and you could see the light in the other end. Apparently this was the main exit.
loc.71.0: You headed to the exit, when a door opened behind your back. A Peleng guard with a laser gun in his hands stepped out. He didn't think twice and shot you dead.
loc.72.0:
You set the explosives and quickly went back to the flyer. Pushing the detonator button you heard a loud explosion. But the base was only damaged - not destroyed. However the base was only damaged and not destroyed. Looks like you should have found a better place for setting the explosives. 

<clr>Mission failed.<clrEnd>
loc.73.0: The shot was not lethal however, and turning on your heel you killed the guard. Having searched his body you found a battery with several laser gun charges.
loc.74.0: You are standing by the prison cells. A dead guard is lying nearby.
loc.76.0: You are standing at a ramification. One corridor on the left, one - on the right, and the third one leading back to the exit.  Nearby there is a door, from behind which you hear voices and laughter.
loc.77.0: You opened the door on the right and went into a small room with a huge power reactor in the middle. Right by the reactor, at a computer there sat a Peleng. Seeing you he quickly jumped up and reached for his weapon.
loc.77.1: Opening the right door you returned to the reactor room.
loc.78.0: Opening the right door you entered a toilet. Looks like this isn't what you've been looking for.
loc.78.1: You are in the toilet at Borzukhan's base.
loc.78.2: You are in the toilet at Borzukhan's base.
loc.78.3: You are in the toilet at Borzukhan's base.
loc.78.4: You are in the toilet at Borzukhan's base.
loc.78.5: You are in the toilet at Borzukhan's base.
loc.79.0: You tried to walk away but the Peleng sounded an alarm and you ran into a group of guards who quickly shot you dead.
loc.80.0: You pulled out you laser gun and shot the Peleng.
loc.80.1: You are in the main reactor room of Borzukhan's base. The killed Peleng is lying at your feet.
loc.81.0: You set the explosives onto the reactor and headed back to the flyer. However there was a surprise committee waiting for you there - Lyakusha Borzukhan himself a laser gun in his hands!
loc.82.0: You set the explosives onto the reactor and headed back to the flyer. Pushing the detonator button you heard a loud explosion and saw a huge mushroom of dust and ash rise from where a second ago was base. Looks like the base has been destroyed! Now you can go back to Carl for your well-deserved reward. Too bad you couldn't take Borzukhan alive...
loc.82.1: You set the explosives onto the reactor and headed back to the flyer. Pushing the detonator button you heard a loud explosion and saw a huge mushroom of dust and ash rise from where a second ago was base. Looks like the base has been destroyed! Now you can go back to Carl for your well-deserved reward. What was even better, you managed to capture Borzukhan alive and that deserved some extra bonus!
loc.82.2:
You set the explosives onto the reactor and headed back to the flyer. Pushing the detonator button you heard a loud explosion and saw a huge mushroom of dust and ash rise from where a second ago was base. Looks like the base has been destroyed!
When you came back to Carl there was some real good news for you there: the test showed that the cabin tenant you killed, turned out to be Borzukhan himself. So you coped with your task very well and will receive your reward.
loc.83.0:
Despite being seriously wounded you managed to concuss Borzukhan. Then pressing the detonator button you watched the base explode 

Having completed your objective you went back to Carl to pick up your well-deserved reward. Since you managed to capture the Lyakusha alive you received an additional bonus of <clr>1000<clrEnd> cr right there at the camp. The rest of the fee - <Money> cr - was to be paid for you back on <FromPlanet>.
loc.84.0:
However after a short fire-exchange you managed to shoot Borzukhan dead. Then pressing the detonator button you watched the base explode 

Mission accomplished. Now you can go back to Carl for your well-deserved reward. Too bad you couldn't take Borzukhan alive...
loc.85.0: You grabbed the gun and started firing at Borzukhan. He crouched behind your flyer and returned the fire. Finally you ran out of ammo and he shot you.
loc.88.0: After some extended torment you finally managed to free yourself.
loc.89.0: You decided you needed to relax and undressing quickly went into the sea. The water was magnificent and you had a great time.
loc.91.0: You took the grenade and threw it right through the window. An explosion thundered sending wooden splinters fly all around the place. When the smoke cleared you noticed pieces of green meat amidst the debris. Looks like this was all that was left of the tenant, although identifying him would surely be a problem now. Well, all you could do now was hope that this was some pirate or probably even Borzukhan himself, and not some innocent hermit. Looks like you'll have to report the incident to Carl, maybe he has some means to identify the corpse.
loc.93.0: You went down the passage and stumbled into a door. You pulled the handle but the door was locked.
loc.94.0: You were quite lucky and stayed alive. On the downside though - now you will have to look for some other way to this base.
loc.95.0: You used your laser gun as a cutter and carefully cut the lock out of the door. You had to spend several charges for that, but now you could go to the base.
loc.96.0: You used your laser gun as a cutter and tried to cut out the lock. Unfortunately the charges you had left were not enough to complete that.
loc.97.0: You went back to the crossing, when suddenly you heard somebody's steps and saw guard walking right at you!
loc.98.0: You rushed past the guard and ran forward. He shot you in the back but missed. You managed to stay alive but you <clr>still failed the mission<clrEnd>, since no one was going to give you a second chance.
loc.99.0: You tried to dash forward past the guard but he tripped you and you fell on the floor. Without giving it a second thought he shot you dead...
loc.102.0:
You hid round the corner and when the guard reached you, you tried to take him out landing the butt of your gun on his Peleng head. However the guard turned out to be a quick bird - ducking the blow and shooting you dead in one swift move...

You died a death of a shadow and failed the mission.
loc.103.0: Although it took quite some effort you still managed to kill all the pirates. The way to the base was free now.
loc.104.0: The wound was not a lethal one and you quickly snatched your own gun. Too late you remembered that you were out of ammo - the next shot of the guard ended your pitiful life...
loc.105.0: The wound was not a lethal one and - turning around swiftly - you shot the guard dead.
loc.106.0: You decided to go back to the camp to get some treatment. You were taken to a medical post where they quickly treated your wounds - unfortunately you didn't have the time for proper treatment, you still had to take care of Borzukhan's base.
loc.107.0: Not giving it a second thought you pulled out your laser gun and shot the guard dead before he even had a chance to see you.
loc.107.1: You grabbed the stunned and quickly took the guard out. It is very unlikely that this guy will come to any time soon. But the stunner was out of battery and regretfully you tossed it away.
loc.107.2: You hid round the corner and when the guard approached quickly jumped on him and took him out landing the butt of your gun on his head. The Peleng dropped to the floor unconscious. Chances are he is not going to come to any time soon after a blow like this.
loc.108.0: You searched the guard but did not find anything useful on him.
loc.108.1: You searched the guard and found out his laser gun was a copy of yours. Using the opportunity you pulled the power-clip from his gun and put it into yours. Although it was partly spent, you still could use a couple of extra rounds.
loc.108.2: Having searched the guard you found a grenade on him, and took it for yourself.
loc.108.3: You searched the guard and found a first-aid kit.
loc.108.4: Having searched the pockets of the killed guard you found <clr>100 cr<clrEnd>! Not a bad bonus to your main fee of <Money> cr, which they promised to you for this mission!
loc.108.5: In the holster of the killed guard you found a stunner. Lucky you!
loc.109.0: You took a first-aid kit and treated your wounds.
loc.111.0: Having searched the body of the killed Peleng, you found an almost spent power clip for a laser gun.
loc.112.0: Finally, after a long wrestling, you managed to take your opponent out. Having searched him you found an almost discharged laser gun clip and also - to your great surprise - saw that you slightly overdid it, when you were hitting the Peleng on the head. He was positively dead.
loc.113.0: Fortunately enough the flyer survived the explosion and with great difficulty you managed to take off and fly away. Then pushing the detonator button you watched the base explode. Mission accomplished. Now you can go back to Carl for your well-deserved reward. Too bad you couldn't take Borzukhan alive...
loc.116.0:
You raised your gun but the Peleng turned out to be faster than you... 

You died and failed your mission.
loc.117.0: You listened a little longer but heard nothing interesting. Time to do something.
loc.118.0: Having searched the guard's body you managed to find a power clip with several charges for a laser gun.

jump.78.text: Carefully move away from the cabin and go back to the flyer
jump.79.text: Shoot Borzukhan from the laser gun
jump.79.desc: You took out your gun, took aim, and shot. The unsuspecting Lyakusha jerked violently and sank down. There was a huge hole in his chest. Well, one problem less - now got to take care of the base.
jump.80.text: Shoot the stunner through the window
jump.82.desc: You shot at Borzukhan from your laser gun, but he ducked and the shot went past him. The Lyakusha reached quickly for his own weapon. But you aimed another time and shot him again. The Lyakusha dropped to the floor but just before he died he still managed to shoot back at you...

jump.89.text: Go down to the sea and inspect the rocks more carefully

jump.106.text: Land the flyer and enter the cave
jump.106.desc: You landed the flyer behind a rock and cautiously stepped into the cave. In front of you there was a long corridor...
jump.107.text: Shoot back from the laser gun
jump.107.desc: You produced your laser gun and returned fire. The pirates fell one after another, but you couldn't constantly duck their shots either...
jump.107.chg.0: You produced your laser gun and returned fire. The pirates fell one after another, but you couldn't constantly duck their shots either. Being wounded already, you could not cope with them and perished...
jump.108.text: Throw a grenade into the crowd

jump.126.desc: You turned and went back to the furcation, however the sound of your steps awoke the guard and he shot you in the back...
jump.127.desc:
You calmly shot the sleeping guard. Next time he won't be sleeping on duty!

Having searched the guard's body you found a clip with several laser charges.
jump.128.desc: You tried to set the explosive, but your fussing awoke the guard, he grabbed his weapon and shot...
jump.147.desc: You grabbed the stunner and jumped on Borzukhan trying to stun him. However he managed to make a couple of rather accurate shots at you...
jump.148.desc: You grabbed the gun and started firing at Borzukhan. He, in turn, crouched behind your flyer and returned the fire..
jump.148.chg.0:
Unfortunately you had been wounded way too many times for such a battle. Several accurate shots from Borzukhan and that was it for you. 

You died and failed your mission terribly.
jump.148.chg.1: Your flyer had been too much damaged in the previous encounters. A chance bullet ran through its energy unit, and you blew up together with Lyakusha...
jump.151.text: Sure, I'll take you to the camp straightaway, let me just check if these scoundrels have anything useful on them...
jump.151.desc: Having searched the bodies of the killed Pelengs, you found several laser gun charges on one of them. Looks like this guy did not have the time to use it. Well, too bad for him, and you really could use some extra ammo. You also picked up the stunner which was used to take out the poor sod, you just rescued. The stunner was almost discharged but it was still good for one or two shots. You took the rescued merchant back to the camp. He was then immediately taken to the medical station. And you had to continue on your mission.
jump.162.desc: You decided to go deeper into the forest and take a better look, since you were sure of your weapons. However you forgot all about the primitive traps and stepped right into one of those, set there on the forest path by some unknown hunter. You struggled desperately to free yourself...
jump.163.text: Go back to the flyer and fly away
jump.165.text: Take a swim in the sea
jump.167.text: Examine the rocks on the coast more carefully
jump.168.text: Die, bastard! (Pull out the laser gun and shoot through the door...)
jump.168.desc: You quickly shot through the door from your laser gun and heard somebody cry. The door swung open and you saw Lyakusha Borzukhan stand the his hands pressed against the wound in his chest and his other two hands still trying to aim the gun at you. You easily ducked his awkward moves and kicked him right in the chest. Borzukhan gasped and dropped dead on the floor. Well, one problem less.
jump.171.text: Go back to the cabin you found
jump.172.text: Throw a grenade into the window
jump.176.desc: You reported back to the camp and told Carl about blowing up the cabin. He wasn't too happy about your hastiness, but assured you he had the means to identify the tenant - or what was left of him. And you have to continue looking for the base.
jump.180.text: Carefully cut out the lock with the laser gun
jump.181.text: Move back and blow up the door with a grenade
jump.181.desc: You went back into the tunnel and threw a grenade at the door. The explosion blasted the door apart, but unfortunately the cave ceiling crumbled too, blocking the entrance forever. You rushed to the exit, but several rather large rocks still scratched you...

jump.197.text: Take the stunned Lyakusha back to the camp.
jump.197.desc: You humped the stunned Lyakusha on your back and dragged him to the flyer. Watching him carefully in case he came to, you flew the flyer back to the camp. Carl was delighted to see you and paid you the promised <clr>1000<clrEnd> cr straight away. However you still need to search and destroy Borzukhan's base.

The pirates fell one after another, but you couldn't keep avoiding their shots either, although the rock behind which you stood was covering well. Being already wounded, you couldn't cope with them all and were killed in action...

jump.240.desc: You jumped over the Peleng and started battering him with the butt of your gun on the head. But he turned out to be one tough dog, resisting violently and even shooting at you a couple of times, although not very accurately...
jump.242.desc: You took a grenade and threw it at Borzukhan. The explosion tore him to pieces, but your flyer was damaged badly too...
jump.242.chg.0: Your flyer exploded. You didn't even have the time to think how you were going to go back to the camp now, because a crowd of guards, apparently summoned by Borzukhan, attacked you. They quickly tore you into pieces with their blasters...
